notes.title: v1.77 Update
notes.content:
Disabled Push during the Ultimate to prevent waste.
 Improved overall readability by ensuring consistent color language.
 Enhanced the readability of the Ultimate Yo-Yo.
 Improved the readability of the Following Bomb.
 Added a UI indicator for Yo-Yo count.
 Enabled the "R" key to recall all Yo-Yos.
 Added enemy death confirmation SFX.
 Introduced the ability to rocket jump using Push.
 Sped up early progression.
 Updated the shield mesh for the heavy enemy type.
 Added tutorial information to the pause menu.
 Improved the end game UI flow.

notes.title: v1.76 Update
notes.content:
Enhanced the visibility of unlit YoYos that are outside the player's line of sight
Allowed pressing Q again to recall and end the ultimate
Made the Ultimate YoYos spawn more in front of the player
Fixed a bug where YoYos sometimes get stuck
Turned XP into a pickup
Adjusted the XP bar location
Extended the kill streak timer by 1 second
Toned down the enemy shooting aggressiveness

notes.title: v1.75 Update & Join Our Discord Server
notes.content:
Join our Discord Server!
Enhanced visibility of the HP pack
Improved leaderboard load times
Adjusted progression balancing
Locked the aspect ratio to support wider monitors
Added fan on/off sound effects
Reinforced the cause-and-effect relationship when activating the fans

notes.title: v1.72 Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Substantial Tick removal
General casting reduction
Cleanup of unused code and references

notes.title: v1.71 Update & Incoming Playtest!
notes.content:
Join the playtest and help improve the core and balancing!

Here's what's included in the updates:

 Introduction of the PowerUps system
 Increased contrast to accommodate different playstyles while doubling down on the core YoYo recall mechanic
 Achievement adjustments
 Global Leaderboard troubleshooting
 Now supports one additional language
